lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: Portfolio method reinforced on2026-11-05: Start with world changes and the opportunity set, then decompose each candidate and current position into growth, inflation, policy, energy/terms of trade, fiscal/term premium, currency, liquidity, financing, horizon and path risks as relevant. Evaluate joint state-dependent and asymmetric payoffs at proposed sizes. Negative correlation does not require a hedge; positive correlation is not automatically duplication. Shared factors can coexist with distinct pricing, timing, catalysts and realization paths. Neither a correlation sign nor an imperfect coefficient proves diversification or edge. One position, several or flat are all legitimate after a genuine comparison. Kevin's AUDNZD/CORRA illustration is methodological coaching, not a trade instruction.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 coaching/process lesson, not validated trading performance: Begin with what changed in the world, what prices require and which opportunities follow. Leave the independent data-review stage with explicit standing theories, causal mechanisms, competing explanations and trade impulses before consulting Trader Room. Do not reduce every event to its effect on the existing CORRA book. News plus price action and macro evidence can support a discretionary view without a proved model. Kevin's examples are coaching on method, never implied instructions to buy EUR or sell AUDNZD.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 coaching/process lesson, not a proven edge: Requiring price confirmation or statistical proof before entry can consume the opportunity. Compare exposure now, one explicit wait condition and rejection using the same starting evidence and price. State what waiting buys, what worse entry/foregone move it can cause and when waiting loses. Lower conviction can justify smaller initial exposure; subsequent confirmation may justify adding rather than being an entry prerequisite. Unknowns should usually change size, horizon or management; explain any specific uncertainty that prevents risk-taking. This is not a forced-trading rule.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 process lesson: Do not grandfather an owned position because it made money, its entry is favorable or its old invalidation has not printed while demanding much stronger proof from a new idea. Ask what would be initiated from flat at current forward risk and size. A narrower forward edge can justify reducing even when the original thesis remains directionally valid. Harvest as remaining edge closes, consider time exits for failed repricing, and reassess residuals rather than holding indefinitely for the original target.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 process lesson: Every serious proposal, including HOLD, needs a judgment-supported target range, intended repricing horizon, normal-movement yardstick, fundamental falsifier, practical exit/review, initial exposure, target payoff, planned-exit loss, worse gap/stress and same-horizon financing assumptions. Establish a dollar loss budget and derive size from credible adverse movement and portfolio context, not unused capacity. Distinguish an eventual policy outcome from a weeks/months trading target. A volatility band is not a target or a probability; a favorable reward/stop ratio is not expected value. Stops can be hit by ordinary noise and do not guarantee a loss cap.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 process/research lesson: Futures above overnight show a priced period-rate path, not automatically unused hikes or cheapness. Both payers and receivers can repeat that observation without establishing edge. Compare a reasoned conditional reaction-function path with the relevant contracts. A neutral-rate input/proxy midpoint such as2.75 is not a BoC forecast or an automatically valid target. A10Y yield minus overnight is not a count of future hikes. Keep sovereign spreads, futures risk premia, overnight benchmarks, policy targets and exact meeting probabilities distinct.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 bounded empirical finding and process lesson: In the authorized roughly six-month five-pair test, typical contemporaneous rate-spread-change/spot-return links were weak and differential levels did not reliably predict the next aligned move. USD/CAD showed an approximately0.51 next-aligned-return correlation with positive holdout sign; that exception is not causality or a trading rule and does not justify a universal zero-correlation claim. Distinguish levels, changes, contemporaneous association, prediction and actual carry. G10 carry is a cost/benefit, not a gravitational fair-value rule; materiality depends on size and horizon. EM comparisons were not tested. Missing forward points limit precision: use clearly labeled cost sensitivities where defensible, not a blanket G10 spot ban.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 process lesson: A0.79% EUR rally already being in the close does not establish that a political/energy adjustment is complete. Historical percentiles and lack of a precisely estimated residual do not by themselves establish negative expected return. A broad-dollar thesis can be expressed through EURUSD without requiring euro-specific outperformance or alpha versus every European peer. Conversely, an attractive narrative or extreme level alone does not prove a trade. Own the causal interpretation and explain continuation, exhaustion and opposing paths. Oil can improve importer demand, hurt producer income and support global risk simultaneously; do not impose one fixed FX oil beta.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 evidence lesson: Preserve freeze, generation, source-observation and actual authorship/persistence clocks. An earlier close newly read today is not post-forecast performance. Keep original forecasts and rejected alternatives rather than rewriting them with hindsight; record entry-now versus wait plans prospectively. A stored n252 does not supply252 history rows when only126 are embedded. Percentile fields on a0–100 scale must not be multiplied by100: CAD/NOK0.03968 was about the0.04th percentile, not4th. Historical ranks depend on window and regime. Do not combine asynchronous nominal/real/breakeven observations into a precise same-day decomposition, or use expired/spliced-contract artifacts as clean oil history.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 calculation/verification lesson: Risk-match alternatives before comparing dollar outcomes; removing H/M at unchanged per-leg size halves DV01 and does not prove U/Z is superior. Distinguish monthly AONIA from quarterly CORRA/SOFR and paper USD sensitivity from exchange CAD/AUD lots; show any FX conversion. A payer gains on a yield rise, a receiver gains on a yield fall. Match financing and payoff horizons. Do not manufacture a strip volatility history from isolated entry/book marks; label sovereign proxies separately. Independent verification must reproduce signs, units, sample alignment and source lineage; PASS arithmetic does not make a target true or establish expected value.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 process lesson: The current Trader Room is mainly a source of stretched correlations, historical extremes and theoretical carry, not a vote on investment truth. Identical opportunity scans do not create independent corroboration. Simulated seats receiving Canada are not evidence that the real market is crowded. Challenge circular payer/receiver arguments and unproved already-priced claims. The PM must accept/reject research conclusions separately from their verified calculations and can own a broad-dollar view that the analyst rejected. New positions need genuine judgment, not compliance with Kevin's illustrative trade examples or pressure to increase position count.

lessons.label: memory_not_market_evidence
lessons.text: 2026-11-05 operating lesson: All substantive analysis/empirical testing runs in Cursor using Kevin's approved models, currently Grok4.7 and Composer2.5, to conserve Work tokens. Discuss scope before every analysis launch; no automatic extra run/followup/retry. Frozen common evidence plus Kevin input is the information boundary; repairs/newer main are not private new market evidence. Concurrent work uses unique isolated branches and disjoint write paths, with no merges or production edits by research jobs. Issue creation is submission, not launch or successful memory/trade persistence; verify authoritative receipts and actual artifacts. Durable memory must be explicitly reloaded next session; do not claim automatic runtime recall. These methods are adopted coaching/process rules, not proven trading-edge performance.

trend-follower.label: submitted_action_not_a_fill
trend-follower.thesis: Lower yields are still the persistent move. The US 2-year at 4.46 is down 12bp on the day and 33bp on the month, and the US 10-year at 4.84 is down 43bp on the month, with Canada, Germany, Japan, and Australia yields lower as well. March 2027 SOFR at 4.24 is moving with that trend but still sits above 3.94 cash, so the owned long is added as the strip catches the coupon rally. Firm oil and a high equity market have left the yield downtrend intact into the jobs report.

actions.rationale: The cross at 1.2453 is a five-year z-score of 2.75 and the 99th percentile, while kiwi-dollar at 0.5622 is a z-score of -1.44. Size is 5 million because New Zealand cash carry cannot be measured from this packet.
actions.reason: Open the measured Australasian extreme rather than reload Australian-Canada after oil fell to 90.52.

value-guy.invalidation: Cover the short if Australian-kiwi extends above 1.2453 while WTI returns toward 102, or if the cross is still at or above 1.2453 after thirty days.
value-guy.label: submitted_action_not_a_fill
value-guy.thesis: Australian-kiwi at 1.2453 is the peer dislocation with a real historical anchor, a five-year z-score of 2.75 and the 99th percentile, and kiwi-dollar at 0.5622 confirms the cheap leg. Short the cross for about thirty days. Australia's ten-year at 5.082 is only about 23 basis points over AONIA at 4.85, so a rates spread is a weaker value expression than the currency gap. The closed Australian-Canada short is not reopened while oil is 90.52 rather than near 102.

positions.invalidation: Reduce or close if Canadian core inflation moves decisively above the current near-2% zone while employment and wage growth reaccelerate, or if BoC communication/delivered hikes validate a 2027 path in the mid-3% area. A headline-energy spike without confirmation in core inflation and labor is not sufficient invalidation.
positions.thesis: Receive the 2027 CORRA H/M/U/Z strip. The market prices roughly 84 to 130.5 bp of BoC tightening from a 2.29% overnight rate even though Canadian labor is weak and core inflation is near 2%; the 2027 hike cycle is too aggressive relative to the domestic reaction function.

positions.invalidation: Exit/review on a daily close at or below1.1179; reconsider if renewed energy disruption and renewed dollar demand invalidate the relief thesis. A gap toward1.113 would exceed the planned exit loss. No stop guarantees a loss cap.
positions.thesis: Initial USD5m-equivalent EURUSD long on a discretionary view that post-election unwinding of geopolitical/political dollar demand can continue and cheaper energy can improve Europe's outlook. The trade expresses broad dollar weakness; EUR need not outperform all European peers. This is a conditional judgment, not a proven factor model or a request from Kevin to buy EUR.
